[[3 ABY]], [[Bestine IV]]The flashbacks of [[Star Wars (2020) 50|''Star Wars'' (2020) 50]] take place approximately twenty-two [[Standard year|years]] after [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine's]] [[Proclamation of the New Order|ascension]] to [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]], meaning they must occur around [[3 ABY]]. The flashbacks also take place after the events of [[Star Wars (2020) 43|''Star Wars'' (2020) 43]], which occur after the ''[[Star Wars: Dark Droids]]'' crossover event, an event {{SW|url=news/marvel-dark-droids-interview|text=Charles Soule Unleashes ''Dark Droids''}} places after ''[[Star Wars: War of the Bounty Hunters]]'', which is dated to 3 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]] by ''Timelines''. As ''Bounty Hunters'' 29 takes place between ''War of the Bounty Hunters'' and ''Dark Droids'', its events, including the [[death]] of the insurgent on [[Bestine IV]], must take place around 3 ABY. |species=[[Humanoid]][[Bounty Hunters 29|''Bounty Hunters'' 29]] |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=[[Color|Dark]] |skin=Light blue |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Bestine IV insurgents]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Nothing else matters besides getting to the bridge and stopping this ship—or my people will die. And so will yours.|The insurgent, to T'onga|}} An '''individual''' was part of a [[Bestine IV insurgents|group]] of insurgents backed by the criminal syndicate [[Crimson Dawn]] that [[Insurrection on Bestine IV|fought]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] on the [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]] [[planet]] [[Bestine IV]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. Around [[3 ABY]], the [[bounty hunter]] [[T'onga]] and her [[T'onga's crew|crew]] were hired by Crimson Dawn to assist the group in intercepting an [[Unidentified Imperial transport|Imperial transport]] that was traveling to an [[Imperial naval base]] with enough munitions to wipe out the insurgents. When meeting the crew, the insurgent was disappointed with the amount of help sent by Crimson Dawn. After boarding the [[transport]], T'onga, the insurgent, and [[Unidentified insurgent 1|two]] [[Unidentified insurgent 2|other]] insurgents headed to the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] but were engaged in a firefight by Imperial [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretroopers]]. During the fight, one of their companions was [[Death|killed]], and the insurgent made way for the bridge, despite T'onga's attempt to stop them from leaving the remaining insurgent behind. Once in the bridge, the insurgent was killed by the [[Imperial officer]] [[Beilert Valance]]. ==Biography== ===Fighting the Empire=== {{Dialogue|Insurgent|Wait, that's it? That's all the help Crimson Dawn sent?|T'onga|Don't worry, we brought a ''Trandoshan''.|Bossk|Hey! I have a name!|T'onga|We brought a Trandoshan named ''Bossk''.|attr=The insurgent, T'onga and Bossk|src=}} [[File:BestineIVInsurgentTongasCrew-BountyHunters29.png|thumb|right|270px|The insurgent (bottom) met with the crew of T'onga (left) and was disappointed with the amount of help sent by Crimson Dawn.]] An individual lived during the [[Imperial Era]]. Around [[3 ABY]], they were part of a [[Bestine IV insurgents|group]] of insurgents backed by the criminal syndicate [[Crimson Dawn]] that [[Insurrection on Bestine IV|fought]] against the [[Galactic Empire]] on [[Bestine IV]]''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]''—an [[Inner Rim Territories|Inner Rim]]{{GalaxyMapAppendix}} — Based on corresponding data for the [[Bestine system]] [[planet]]—and was based in a [[Unidentified village (Bestine IV)|village]] on the island [[Jahnae]] whose inhabitants worked as support staff for an [[Imperial naval base]] located not far from the [[City|village]]. Around that [[Standard year|year]], Crimson Dawn came into the possession of intel that the Empire was sending a [[Unidentified Imperial transport|transport]] to the base with enough munitions to crush the insurgents and hired the [[T'onga's crew|crew]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[T'onga]] to help the insurgents crash the [[transport]] before it reached the [[Imperial Navy|naval]] base. Arranging a rendezvous point with T'onga and her crew, the insurgent, along with [[Unidentified insurgent 1|two]] [[Unidentified insurgent 2|others]], traveled there aboard [[speeder bike]]s, and as T'onga's [[Eskherf-class shuttle|ship]]—the [[Edgehawk (starship)|''Edgehawk'']]—landed, the insurgent held up their [[Limb|hand]]. They stood at the bottom of the ''Edgehawk''{{'s}} [[entry ramp]] as the crew departed, and upon spotting it was only five individuals, asked if that was all the help that Crimson Dawn had sent. In response, T'onga pointed out that she had brought a [[Trandoshan]] named [[Bossk'wassak'Cradossk|Bossk]] with them and stated her hope the insurgent had brought enough [[speeder]]s for them all as they had a lot of ground to cover, noting they should get started as the Imperial transport had reached land. ===Infiltrating the Imperial transport=== {{Quote|Wait, why are the lights down?''"
"''There's no time. I can see well enough to reach the control panel.''"
"''Something is not right—|T'onga and the insurgent, before the insurgent is killed|}} [[File:BestineIVInsurgentTonga-BountyHunters29.png|thumb|left|350px|After the death of one of their comrades, the insurgent headed to the transport's bridge along with T'onga.]] The insurgents and T'onga's crew made their way to the transport aboard their speeder bikes and, upon arriving, climbed aboard with a [[grappling hook]]. Once aboard, T'onga told the insurgent to stay sharp in case of nearby sentries, and after [[Tasu Leech]]—one of T'onga's crew—[[Death|beheaded]] a pair of Imperial [[Coastal defender stormtrooper|shoretroopers]], T'onga and the three insurgents headed for the transport's [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]]. When they reached the outside of the bridge, they were caught in a firefight with more [[Stormtrooper|shoretroopers]]. After T'onga stated they had to reach the bridge before reinforcements from the base were sent to the transport, one of the insurgent's companions was killed, and the insurgent headed toward the bridge, informing T'onga to go with them as they were outnumbered. The [[bounty]] [[Hunting|hunter]] said they could not leave the other [[soldier]] behind, to which the insurgent replied their fallen comrade knew the risks and was prepared to risk his life. They added that getting to the bridge and stopping the transport was all that mattered, since both their people and T'onga's crew would die otherwise. After entering the bridge, the bounty hunter questioned why its lights were down, though the insurgent told her there was no time to wonder and that they could see well enough to reach a [[control panel]]. T'onga expressed concern that something was not right. Moments later, the insurgent was shot and killed by the [[Imperial officer]] [[Beilert Valance]], an old friend of the bounty hunter. Ultimately, the transport was destroyed before it reached the base, and the village where the insurgents had been hiding was [[bomb]]ed by the Empire.[[Bounty Hunters 31|''Bounty Hunters'' 31]] ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Come on! There're too many of them!''"
"''We can't just leave your soldier behind.''"
"''He knew the risks. He's willing to sacrifice for the cause.|The insurgent and T'onga|}} The individual was a [[humanoid]] with [[Color|dark]] [[eye]]s and light blue skin. When meeting the bounty hunter T'onga and her crew, the insurgent was underwhelmed at the amount of support sent to them by Crimson Dawn. The insurgent was prepared to leave their fellow insurgents behind for the cause of fighting the Galactic Empire, and when T'onga tried to stop them, they stated reaching the bridge and stopping the Imperial transport was all that mattered. ==Equipment== {{Quote|I hope you brought enough speeders.|T'onga, to the insurgent|}} The insurgent had a tan satchel with three gray cylinders attached to its strip, one gray [[metal]]lic wrist guard, and a [[pauldron]]. In combat, they utilized a [[blaster rifle]]. The insurgent wore brown [[glove]]s, dark-colored [[boot]]s, and a long, [[cloak]]-like piece of [[clothing]] that covered their head, with a small slit for their eyes. They made use of a speeder bike. ==Behind the scenes== The Bestine IV insurgent first appeared in the [[Bounty Hunters 29|twenty-ninth issue]] of the [[2020]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunters]]''. The issue was written by [[Ethan Sacks]], illustrated by [[Paolo Villanelli]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[December 14]], [[2022]]. Prior to its release, the insurgent was included in a preview of the issue that was published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 7]] of the same year.{{SW|url=news/marvel-star-wars-bounty-hunters-29-exclusive-preview|text=IG-88 Joins the Fray in Marvel's ''Star Wars: Bounty Hunters'' #29 – Exclusive Preview}} ==Appearances== *[[Bounty Hunters 29|''Bounty Hunters'' 29]] {{1st}} *[[Bounty Hunters 30|''Bounty Hunters'' 30]] {{Corpse}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/marvel-star-wars-bounty-hunters-29-exclusive-preview|text=IG-88 Joins the Fray in Marvel's ''Star Wars: Bounty Hunters'' #29 – Exclusive Preview}} {{1stm}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of unidentified Bestine IV insurgent}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=ბესტინ IV-ის უცნობი მეამბოხე }} [[Category:Bestine IV residents]] [[Category:Freedom fighters]] [[Category:Humanoids]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]]
